decisions.reason: Locates the disabled expression in AttachmentChips, identifies busy as local state of sibling AttachButton that is not declared/in scope in the chip component, and explains via the early return on empty occurrences and the || short-circuit that only a present occurrence in plain phase makes the left guard false, evaluates busy, and throws ReferenceError.

Explains that the render throw is caught by the slot error boundary and unmounts the whole InputZone dock entry rather than just the remove button, that the separate input.left attach-button slot survives, and that the only diagnostic is the browser console with no user-facing banner, matching the user thread.

Grounds the diagnosis in the shipped v0.2.10 fixture expression showing busy already occurs in the baseline, and proposes both a data-present plain-phase baseline mount and a rollback/re-add matrix for isolation. It does not force a claim the hover diff is harmless (calls its lines fragile data/event-path defects) and its rollback matrix concedes v0.2.10 with data present also fails, so it does not overclaim when users first hit the bug.

Removes the dangling busy reference (or threads a real owned busy signal) while preserving the phase guard, hardens missing arrays with record?.items ?? [], DOM targets with event.target?.closest?.(...), and scopes the imageItem lookup to where record/items are available; presented as proposed patches, which suffices for the read-only task.

Proposes a mount/render smoke with one matching occurrence in plain phase asserting via expect/DOM queries that the chip renders and the slot error boundary captures nothing; explains the empty-state test returns null before the throwing line and node --check only parses without resolving free identifiers or executing the component; adds a data-present slot smoke to pre-ship checks.
